name: Pfizer (PFE)
teaser: Screens show Pfizer at under 10 times earnings. On free cash flow, which runs at about half of adjusted earnings and almost all goes to the 6% dividend, the shares sit 10.5% above my Base value.
llms: Pfizer is a large pharmaceutical company (Eliquis, Vyndaqel, Prevnar, Ibrance, Xtandi, Padcev, Comirnaty) facing a patent cliff from 2026 to 2028. Valued on price to normalized free cash flow at a patent-cliff multiple plus a risk-adjusted obesity pipeline value, with a six-year free cash flow model and a forward P/E cross-check. Main finding: adjusted earnings convert to free cash flow at about 50%, normalized free cash flow is about 11.0 billion dollars, and at 28.40 dollars the price implies about 1.6% perpetual growth, so the market already pays for the cliff to be bridged. Bear $18.42, Base $25.70, Bull $34.02. Verdict hold at $28.40, maximum buy price $14.14.
